ABSTRACT 
Methods for making heat transfer devices include forming a 
jet plate with a plurality of inclined jets set at an angular 
deviation from normal 
. A bottom plate is formed with 
channel walls that have ribs . The jet plate is attached to the 
bottom plate to form ribbed channels . The angular deviation 
of each inclined jet establishes a jet direction perpendicular 
to a long dimension of the ribbed channels .
